an6.103:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ.
an6.103:1.3: sabbasaṅkhāresu ca me nibbidasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā bhavissati seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake.
an6.103:1.4: sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati. nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi. anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchanti. kiccakārī ca bhavissāmi. satthā ca me pariciṇṇo bhavissati mettāvatāyātī.
an6.103:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetunti.
